message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020:

| # | Title | Director | Key Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern twist on the classic horror tale, it blends psychological suspense with social commentary on abuse and gaslighting. |
| 2 | **Tenet** | Christopher Nolan | John David Washington, Robert Pattinson | Though more sci‑fi, its intricate time‑travel mechanics create a tense, high‑stakes thriller atmosphere. |
| 3 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen | A courtroom drama that doubles as a political thriller, capturing the tension of the 1969 protest trial. |
| 4 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A Danish film that turns a simple hunting trip into a chilling psychological thriller about paranoia and betrayal. |
| 5 | **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam | A stylish gangster caper with witty dialogue and a fast‑paced plot full of twists. |
| 6 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A long‑form crime epic that uses de‑aged actors to explore decades of mob history, blending drama with thriller elements. |
| 7 | **The Night House** | David Bruckner | Rebecca Hall, Nathan Lane | A supernatural thriller that keeps viewers guessing with its slow‑burn tension and atmospheric dread. |
| 8 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime‑drama that builds suspense through a medieval duel and the mystery surrounding it. |
| 9 | **The Platform** | Galder Gaztelu-Urrutia | Iván Massagué, Zorion Eguileor | A Spanish dystopian thriller that uses claustrophobic setting to explore class conflict and survival. |
|10 | **The Midnight Sky** | George Clooney | George Clooney, Felicity Jones | While primarily a sci‑fi, its tense narrative about a lone scientist trying to warn humanity adds thriller stakes. |

These films were praised for their direction, performances, and ability to keep audiences on edge throughout. If you’re looking for a mix of psychological tension, action, and clever plotting, any of these should satisfy your craving for a good crime‑thriller.
